text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: It's showtime!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-kun, to wrap up this year,
shall we hold a dinner & opera show?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the end of the year, T.M. Opera O decided
to rent out the Academy's cafeteria
to hold a party.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, only one reporter showed up after my debut race,
which was rather unexpected, but—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I know, I know full well.
Today only looks empty
—it's actually the packed-to-capacity pattern!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, sorry to keep you waiting!
Hosted by me! Starring me! The party starts now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Silence...)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun.
Who else could it be but you?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I'm here too...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san, this year, umm...
thank you so much...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Plus Doto...?! No, isn't this really
getting a bit too repetitive...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Still, does this mean my fame... is really only limited to this level...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, how cruel...
How truly pitiable..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
TM Opera O slumps her shoulders in defeat.
Even for her, this level of emptiness is...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To think you still haven't noticed my presence!
Even though Lohengrin, the true hero, is standing right before your eyes!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Why do you turn your eyes away from the heir to the Holy Grail?
No, perhaps you simply do not know. In that case—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, I shall win and keep on winning.
Schedule as many races as you wish!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O was not discouraged in the slightest.
Her mental fortitude truly is top-star caliber.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um... Opera O-san. There's a reason why
no one's gathering today at all...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I think... I'm not entirely sure, but I wonder
if they might have gone over that way.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Over that way... meaning where?

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Hello, everyone! Welcome to the
"Year-End Umamusume Special Fan Event!"

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Today's lineup is super star-studded!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
First up are El Condor Pasa-san and
Special Week-san, who gave stellar performances
in the recent Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hello, desu! Did you get a good look
at El's glorious victory, desu ka~?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I-I gave it all I had!
...Even though I came in 3rd place.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Next, scheduled to run in the upcoming Arima Kinen,
Grass Wonder-san and Seiun Sky-san!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hiiii~♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Merry good evening to you~

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, to think such an event was being held behind the scenes...!
I see, so that's how it is!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"A special event bringing together four members
of the generation right above us, known as the 'Golden Generation'!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
So a lot of fans were intrigued by the 1-vs-4 odds
and came over to watch.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Even though I'm clearly the more charming one
here..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hm, wait a sec? What if I were to just
jump right into this circle—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Wouldn't doing it that way be better for everyone?
It throws off the schedule, but what we'll gain
should be so much bigger!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go! This too is for the public good!
In other words, a Star's duty!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Well, well, everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san, wait...! If we disturb them,
something terrible is gonna happen, you knowww...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Desperately holding back alongside Meisho Doto,
we returned to the original venue.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: And so, I find myself right back in this quiet stronghold.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Well, they have visible results on their side. That probably makes it easier to draw a crowd.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, and yet the true leading star has only
just taken the stage!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: It's about time I made them realize. I have to open the audience's eyes myself.
choice_data_list: Next year, we turn the tables.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Of course, Trainer.
They say talking about next year makes the ogres laugh, but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Before the demons can laugh, I'll laugh first!
Next year, this venue will be packed with fans!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!
Bwahahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Whew, dinner's gotten quite late...
I wonder if the cafeteria is still open...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...What's with this laughter?
...Who is it?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Is that... T.M. Opera O?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I really don't want to get involved...
I'll just pretend I didn't see anything..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oho, what's this! A fan, my very first fan has arrived!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...!? I've been spotted!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming. Please, eat and drink your fill,
and enjoy my one-man show.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No, I won't look, but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're... Admire Vega from my generation, right?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Why such a gloomy face?
You should take in plenty of my charms today and refresh yourself!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I really don't need it, seriously...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the final event of the year came to a modest close, with a wandering Admire Vega dragged into the mix.
